d: First word in how an Oct. 22 OpenAI post describes the decisions its new Decisions API makes for apps, ahead of focused and low-cost
Part of an act in a play
n: An Oct. 22 post introduced an interface built for fast, focused, low-cost decisions inside apps. Plenty of the choices an app makes are small: which folder a message goes in, whether a request needs a person. For those, a quick, cheap call often fits better than the largest model available, so match the size of the tool to the size of the decision.
